findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Widen the grep-AC exception to explicitly allow the `--force-close` match-token literal(s) inside `_parse_flags` (the rejecting branch), not just the 'rejection message/test'.
evidence: Approach: 'the parser therefore gets an explicit rejecting branch for both `--force-close` and `--force-close=<v>`' — the branch must compare the incoming token against the literal string `--force-close`

AC: 'returns no hits other than the CHANGELOG.md entry ... and the parser's rejection message/test' — 'rejection message' names --force, so the match-token literal is a third, unenumerated legitimate hit
findings.finding: The grep acceptance criterion permits `--force-close` hits only in 'the CHANGELOG.md entry ... and the parser's rejection message/test', but the parser must retain `--force-close` as a literal MATCH TOKEN in _parse_flags to detect and reject it — and that literal appears in source code, distinct from the human-facing rejection message (which names `--force`, not `--force-close`).
scenarios: Executor runs the grep AC and finds the match-token literal in transition.py, is unsure whether it is an allowed exception, and either wrongly 'fixes' it (breaking rejection) or the AC reads as failing.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to: '... returns no hits other than the CHANGELOG.md entry and the `--force-close` token literals/message in the parser's rejecting branch and its test.'

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State the back-out explicitly (e.g. 'revert this commit restores `--force-close`') and note the loud-fail rejection branch is the intended caller-migration mechanism.

findings.finding: The plan is an acknowledged breaking change (clean break, no alias) but states no explicit back-out/rollback mechanism; per the compat rubric the remedy for a breaking change is an explicit rollback plan OR expand-contract, and the plan deliberately declines expand-contract.
scenarios: If the rename proves disruptive to unmigrated automation, operators need a stated back-out path.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one line under Approach: 'Back-out: this is a single-commit CLI rename; reverting the commit fully restores `--force-close`. The rejecting branch is the caller-migration signal in lieu of an alias.'
